info.title: HireMe API
info.description: Hire out equipment: owners list machinery with a daily rate in KES, clients book it for a date range. Log in with POST /api/v1/auth/login, then click Authorize and paste the token.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Register and log in (no token needed)

tags.name: Bookings
tags.description: Bookings and their lifecycle: PENDING → CONFIRMED → ACTIVE → COMPLETED, or CANCELLED

put.summary: Update a listing you own (ADMIN: any)
put.description: Only the fields you send are changed. Send `"status": "UNDER_MAINTENANCE"` to stop new bookings.

delete.summary: Delete a listing you own (ADMIN: any)

409.description: It has pending, confirmed or active bookings that end today or later

put.description: Re-checks the dates, then cancels the other PENDING bookings that overlap them.

409.description: Not PENDING, dates already booked, or changed by someone else meanwhile

put.summary: Complete a CONFIRMED or ACTIVE booking (equipment owner)

409.description: Not CONFIRMED or ACTIVE, or changed by someone else meanwhile

put.summary: Cancel a booking (its client or the equipment owner)
put.description: Once a booking is ACTIVE only the owner can cancel it.

409.description: Already COMPLETED or CANCELLED, or changed by someone else meanwhile

get.summary: Search listings, one page at a time
get.description: All filters are optional and combine with AND.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Case-insensitive "contains", e.g. `nakuru` matches `Nakuru Town`

parameters.name: minRate
parameters.description: Lowest daily rate in KES, included

parameters.name: maxRate
parameters.description: Highest daily rate in KES, included

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords matched against name, location and description (any of them)

parameters.name: availableFrom
parameters.description: With `availableTo`: only listings that take bookings and are free on every day. ISO date

parameters.name: availableTo
parameters.description: Last day, included. ISO date; one date alone means that single day

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page number

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `dailyRateKes`, `createdAt` or `name`, optionally followed by `,asc` or `,desc`. Default `createdAt,desc` (newest first).

post.description: e.g. "a tractor in Nakuru next weekend under 8000 a day". The AI turns it into the filters of GET /api/v1/equipment (returned in `filters`, for the UI to show and edit) and the normal search runs with them. If AI is unavailable or over the limit, the words are matched instead (`interpretedBy: KEYWORDS`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page number

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: As for GET /api/v1/equipment

200.description: The interpreted filters and the matching listings

post.summary: Draft a listing title and description (OWNER, ADMIN)
post.description: Also suggests a daily rate from similar listings, with a one-line reason. Nothing is saved: show the draft to the owner, who accepts or edits it before creating the listing.

429.description: Too many AI requests from this user in the last minute

503.description: AI is turned off or Groq is unavailable

post.summary: Book equipment for a date range (CLIENT, ADMIN)
post.description: Starts as PENDING. Both start and end dates are booked days and both are charged.

409.description: Listing under maintenance, or dates already booked

post.summary: Register a client or owner account
Log in and get a JWT

get.description: Confirmed or active bookings overlapping [from, to]. At most 366 days.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day, ISO date. Default today (Africa/Nairobi)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day, included. Default 90 days from `from`

get.summary: Get a booking (its client or the equipment owner)
The caller's bookings, one page at a time

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page number

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `startDate` or `creationDate`, optionally followed by `,asc` or `,desc`. Default `creationDate,desc` (newest first).

get.summary: Bookings on the caller's equipment, one page at a time

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only bookings with this status, e.g. PENDING for requests waiting for you

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page number

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `startDate` or `creationDate`, optionally followed by `,asc` or `,desc`. Default `creationDate,desc` (newest first).
